subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Is the reporter's v2026.6.11 evidence enough to sponsor a fix now, or should maintainers require a current-main Docker repro that separates scheduled heartbeat from manual wake routing first?
rationale: Current source already carries agentId through the obvious scheduled and targeted paths, while the latest reporter steps use an untargeted manual wake that has different source behavior.

options.title: Require current-main live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for or run a current-main Docker repro before queueing a fix so the exact entry path is known.

options.title: Sponsor narrow source repair now
options.body: Queue a maintainer-owned repair only if maintainers accept that the source-level manual wake/default-agent path is the bug to fix.

options.title: Close as already implemented
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the remaining report is an unsupported manual trigger path rather than a per-agent heartbeat defect.

recommendation.title: Require current-main live repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for or run a current-main Docker repro before queueing a fix so the exact entry path is known.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent multi-agent heartbeat work most directly adjacent to the scheduler and per-agent heartbeat behavior under review.
